title: ervatamia citrifolia
intro: Ervatamia citrifolia, commonly known as the Citrus Tree Climber, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ervatamia citrifolia include acting as an anti-inflammatory agent, analgesic, and antimicrobial agent, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
